name: Teide National Park
description: Teide National Park covers the volcanic heart of Tenerife in Spain's Canary Islands. Its centrepiece, Mount Teide, rises 3,718 m, the highest point in Spain, and measures about 7,500 m from the ocean floor. Visitors can gaze across shifting colours and textures of lava terrain, often above a "sea of clouds," and stargazers also come for the observatory's clear skies.
